programme.title: 野生动物明星 #1
programme.desc: 每一天在非洲都上演为生存而挣扎的戏码。捕猎者狂欢,而大自然的拾尸者亦在等待牠们的机会。当强者死亡时,一支军队来吞噬别人留下的东西,因为牠们也必须养育宝贵的家庭。

programme.title: 迷忘国度 #2
programme.desc: 塞拉利昂戈达位于墨西哥中部的中心地带,是一个由许多生态组成的地区。从海拔300至3000米拔地而起,从古老的半沙漠化低山开始,进入一片茂密的绿色云雾森林,当中栖息著山猫、美洲狮和飞鼠。

programme.title: 迷忘国度 #3
programme.desc: 很少地方比索诺兰沙漠更美丽、更严峻。探索风吹沙,高耸的火山峰,并深入外星般的陨石坑。于这个被遗忘的荒野中,缺水的动植物只有适应或者死亡。

programme.title: 上城水獭 #4
programme.desc: 欢迎安娜的族群回到海滨湾, 那里有两个擅自闯入的水獭家族。当米娅嗅到安娜的气味并将汤尼族群赶得远远的时候,牠感受到了压力。然后,当游牧族群对即将发生的冲突一无所知时,请抓紧时间。

programme.title: 野小子 #1
programme.desc: 与美洲虎幼崽弗里达一起探索极限,她正在巴西的凯门保护区磨练自己的生存技能。学习如何与妈妈加图纳一起潜行、看姐姐阿努克帮助她躲避饥饿的入侵者,最后进行一次冒险但幸运的单独跋涉,。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #4
programme.desc: 跟随麦克斯来到卢安达的森林追踪黑猩猩,他试图说服这些强壮的猴子相信他是朋友而非敌人。一起学习在丛林觅食的关键技巧,并见证黑猩猩复杂的家庭动态,包括梳理毛发和社交活动。

programme.title: 迷忘国度 #2
programme.desc: 塞拉利昂戈达位于墨西哥中部的中心地带,是一个由许多生态组成的地区。从海拔300至3000米拔地而起,从古老的半沙漠化低山开始,进入一片茂密的绿色云雾森林,当中栖息著山猫、美洲狮和飞鼠。

programme.title: 迷忘国度 #3
programme.desc: 很少地方比索诺兰沙漠更美丽、更严峻。探索风吹沙,高耸的火山峰,并深入外星般的陨石坑。于这个被遗忘的荒野中,缺水的动植物只有适应或者死亡。

programme.title: 上城水獭 #4
programme.desc: 欢迎安娜的族群回到海滨湾, 那里有两个擅自闯入的水獭家族。当米娅嗅到安娜的气味并将汤尼族群赶得远远的时候,牠感受到了压力。然后,当游牧族群对即将发生的冲突一无所知时,请抓紧时间。

programme.title: 野小子 #1
programme.desc: 与美洲虎幼崽弗里达一起探索极限,她正在巴西的凯门保护区磨练自己的生存技能。学习如何与妈妈加图纳一起潜行、看姐姐阿努克帮助她躲避饥饿的入侵者,最后进行一次冒险但幸运的单独跋涉,。

programme.title: 「非」常野外又一年 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在南非,春天在九月初显现端倪,大自然生气盎然。白昼渐长,气温升高。万物复苏,生机勃勃。

programme.title: 「非」常野外又一年 #2 英普
programme.desc: 非洲的夏天是极端的季节,它划分出了弱者与强者。它考验著猎豹、狮子、壁虎、海龟和更多物种在酷热的夏天寻找食物和水的生存本能。

programme.title: 野生动物明星 #1
programme.desc: 每一天在非洲都上演为生存而挣扎的戏码。捕猎者狂欢,而大自然的拾尸者亦在等待牠们的机会。当强者死亡时,一支军队来吞噬别人留下的东西,因为牠们也必须养育宝贵的家庭。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #1
programme.desc: 认识新任野外战士义工,他们将加入韦札的动物大家庭。变脏是工作的一部分。当然,随时会有冲击性的惊喜。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #2
programme.desc: 我们在本集目睹一场拯救一只受惊黑高角羚的绝望任务。这些反偷猎的大象智慧震惊所有人。而且,总能忙里偷闲。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #3
programme.desc: 义工们在本集近距离接触标志性的动物。深入了解韦札的反偷猎成就。还有,努力无坚不摧。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #4
programme.desc: 义工们探索社区在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人兴奋的蜂蜜收成、新团员的加入,以及其中一人喂哺黑犀牛的梦想成真。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #5
programme.desc: 在引人入胜的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的梦想。茱迪心爱的麂羚是时候回归大自然。例行的东非条纹羚捕捉行动发生意想不到的转折。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #6
programme.desc: 在本集一个疣猪回收行动出了差错。来认识韦札保育区的母系社会,一头奇特大象的独家故事。是时候告别韦札的家人。

programme.title: 犀牛孤儿院 #1
programme.desc: 在犀牛孤儿院需要耐性与忠诚,因为他们要抚养那些因偷猎而失去母亲的年轻犀牛。

programme.title: 犀牛孤儿院 #2
programme.desc: 两头最老的犀牛将重返大自然。三头犀牛的失踪引起哄动,而年轻的犀牛则逐渐康复和变得快乐。

programme.title: 犀牛孤儿院 #3
programme.desc: 偷猎危机加剧,偷猎者将注意力转向孤儿们。四周大的牙美拿失去母亲后终于在犀牛孤儿院找到庇护。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #1
programme.desc: 随著日照越短、天气越寒冷,加拿大的野生动物正与时间竞赛,任何无法好好利用秋天作准备的动物都将灭亡。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #2
programme.desc: 加拿大的冬天既残酷又美丽;动物们在冰天雪地里挣扎求存;不过,虽然有些动物会静候蓄力,另一些需要抚养孩子的动物则需要迅速适应环境。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #3
programme.desc: 今年有一个迟来的春天,但当它终于来到,寻觅配偶和组织家庭的竞赛就正式开展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的树蛙,东部的两万只塘鹅,不分地域都想著同一件事。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #4
programme.desc: 夏季对大部分动物来说都是丰收的季节,但对北极熊却相反。在海洋再度结冰前,牠们无法捕猎海豹,导致日益饥饿。对其他动物来说,夏天是幼崽们必须学习如何生存的时机。

programme.title: 大卫艾登堡: 自然本色 #1
programme.desc: 数百万年前,第一批长有眼睛的动物无法分辨颜色—但随著情况改变,无论是寻找食物、吸引配偶还是警告敌人,「看见色彩」令动物拥有很多优势。

programme.title: 大卫艾登堡: 自然本色 #2
programme.desc: 大卫艾登堡揭示大自然中一些最狡猾的骗子和伪装大师。发掘一些动物如何使用颜色隐藏并消失在背景中,或是耍诡计和欺骗。

programme.title: 大卫艾登堡: 自然本色 #3
programme.desc: 找出对动物颜色的科学研究背后的故事—从机械青蛙到现实世界对应物种间的角力,到蜘蛛画眼线来吸引配偶。

programme.title: 自然保护区 #1
programme.desc: 领略纳米比亚千公里的狂野海岸!干旱沙漠中生命顽强绽放,本片捕捉了万物在极端环境下生存的壮丽奇景。一同见证超越极限的生命之美!

programme.title: 自然保护区 #2
programme.desc: 从落基山脉到太平洋,英属哥伦比亚是生物多样性的瑰宝!在辽阔大地追随灰熊的霸气身影。这是一片庄严且神圣、亟需我们守护的原始荒野!

programme.title: 自然保护区 #3
programme.desc: 生命自会找到出路!随风漂流而来的物种,让加勒比海成为全球生物多样性热点。深入探索这些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生态系,感受海岛生机。

programme.title: 自然保护区 #4
programme.desc: 穿越时空!探索昆士兰古老的湿地与原生雨林。这里栖息著史前时代的幸存者,带您踏上一场通往热带澳洲起源的生命活力之旅。

programme.title: 自然保护区 #5
programme.desc: 国土虽小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加拥有全球 5% 的物种。从山巅到海岸,亲身体会守护这座丰富生命圣殿对地球是多么至关重要。

programme.desc: 加拿大的冬天既残酷又美丽;动物们在冰天雪地里挣扎求存;不过,虽然有些动物会静候蓄力,另一些需要抚养孩子的动物则需要迅速适应环境。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #3
programme.desc: 今年有一个迟来的春天,但当它终于来到,寻觅配偶和组织家庭的竞赛就正式开展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的树蛙,东部的两万只塘鹅,不分地域都想著同一件事。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #4
programme.desc: 夏季对大部分动物来说都是丰收的季节,但对北极熊却相反。在海洋再度结冰前,牠们无法捕猎海豹,导致日益饥饿。对其他动物来说,夏天是幼崽们必须学习如何生存的时机。

programme.title: 大卫艾登堡: 自然本色 #1
programme.desc: 数百万年前,第一批长有眼睛的动物无法分辨颜色—但随著情况改变,无论是寻找食物、吸引配偶还是警告敌人,「看见色彩」令动物拥有很多优势。

programme.title: 大卫艾登堡: 自然本色 #2
programme.desc: 大卫艾登堡揭示大自然中一些最狡猾的骗子和伪装大师。发掘一些动物如何使用颜色隐藏并消失在背景中,或是耍诡计和欺骗。

programme.title: 大卫艾登堡: 自然本色 #3
programme.desc: 找出对动物颜色的科学研究背后的故事—从机械青蛙到现实世界对应物种间的角力,到蜘蛛画眼线来吸引配偶。

programme.title: 自然保护区 #1
programme.desc: 领略纳米比亚千公里的狂野海岸!干旱沙漠中生命顽强绽放,本片捕捉了万物在极端环境下生存的壮丽奇景。一同见证超越极限的生命之美!

programme.title: 自然保护区 #2
programme.desc: 从落基山脉到太平洋,英属哥伦比亚是生物多样性的瑰宝!在辽阔大地追随灰熊的霸气身影。这是一片庄严且神圣、亟需我们守护的原始荒野!

programme.title: 自然保护区 #3
programme.desc: 生命自会找到出路!随风漂流而来的物种,让加勒比海成为全球生物多样性热点。深入探索这些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生态系,感受海岛生机。

programme.title: 自然保护区 #4
programme.desc: 穿越时空!探索昆士兰古老的湿地与原生雨林。这里栖息著史前时代的幸存者,带您踏上一场通往热带澳洲起源的生命活力之旅。

programme.title: 自然保护区 #5
programme.desc: 国土虽小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加拥有全球 5% 的物种。从山巅到海岸,亲身体会守护这座丰富生命圣殿对地球是多么至关重要。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #1
programme.desc: 认识新任野外战士义工,他们将加入韦札的动物大家庭。变脏是工作的一部分。当然,随时会有冲击性的惊喜。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #2
programme.desc: 我们在本集目睹一场拯救一只受惊黑高角羚的绝望任务。这些反偷猎的大象智慧震惊所有人。而且,总能忙里偷闲。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #3
programme.desc: 义工们在本集近距离接触标志性的动物。深入了解韦札的反偷猎成就。还有,努力无坚不摧。

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #1
programme.desc: 在圣露西亚,双胞胎惊喜现身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探险、丛林健行、极致享受的巧克力按摩、兰姆酒品鉴,热带乐趣无限延伸!

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #2
programme.desc: 在冰岛,邦妮与双胞胎展开史诗冒险——赏鲸、火山健行、策马奔驰,还有极光下的深度环保对话。

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #3
programme.desc: 在杜拜,路克全力挑战肾上腺素极限: 潜水探险、水上飞行器、挥杆高尔夫、快艇狂飙——最后边晚餐边畅聊《哈利波特》回忆,输家买单!

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #4
programme.desc: 在波兰,苏菲抛下宁静假期,换来满满刺激: 征服壮丽塔特拉山、漂流急湍河道、探访传奇盐矿,精彩不间断!

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #5
programme.desc: 在因斯布鲁克,双胞胎带海莉闯入阿尔卑斯仙境,飞驰滑雪、雪车冲刺、尽情畅饮,重温童星荣耀时刻——还有神秘魔法惊喜!

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #6
programme.desc: 在爱尔兰,双胞胎与伊凡娜一家共享曲棍球对决、传统舞蹈、《哈利波特》回忆杀,并揭开诡谲迷人的乡间冒险序幕!

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中国 #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明来到母亲的家乡北京,在中国这个古老国家开展烹饪、历史和个人之旅。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中国 #2
programme.desc: 崇明参观了山峦起伏的美丽省份- 安徽,这是中国八大菜系之一的故乡。徽菜是诚恳的农家菜,采用时令山野食材烹调而成。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中国 #3
programme.desc: 崇明继续透过美食探索中国历史的旅程,他到访江苏省和浙江省,它们也位列中国八大菜系之中,并以其丰盛和精致而闻名。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中国 #4
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵访世上最大的城市之一上海,他在当地发现一个现代化、国际化、全球化的城市。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中国 #5
programme.desc: 崇明在透过美食探索中国历史的旅程中,来到山东—孔子的故乡,也是中国最古老和最有影响力的烹饪传统源地之一。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中国 #6
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵达中国最迷人的省份之一—云南。 充满了来自东南亚和中亚的香料和芬芳,各地的中国人都爱上这里的美食和文化。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中国 #7
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵达炎热的四川省和湖南省,而这次著名厨师兼作家,同时也是当地的专家导游邓扶霞也一并同行。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中国 #8
programme.desc: 廖崇明身在福建,当地是一个有著悠久移民历史的地方,他们迁移所留下的持久痕迹,体现在其饮食和文化上。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中国 #9
programme.desc: 廖崇明前往粤菜之乡-香港和广东,探索传到世界各地的地区美食。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中国 #10
programme.desc: 廖崇明的最后一站是非常特别的海南岛—一个气候宜人的热带岛屿,也是崇明祖先的家乡。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年来制作海南鸡饭的心得。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #2
programme.desc: 廖崇明从当地穆斯林家庭学习制作正宗巴东牛肉。他到访新加坡国家档案馆查找母亲家族的资料,并继续寻找新加坡国宴的灵感。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #3
programme.desc: 廖崇明到访峇峇娘惹美食传奇人物温美玉的餐厅- 国家厨房。然后,他前往牛车水参观澳洲人大卫偏特的餐厅- Burnt Ends。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #4
programme.desc: 廖崇明寻找新加坡最好的海鲜。他从滨海湾金沙酒店出发,那里有许多名厨开设的餐厅。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #5
programme.desc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛顿熟食中心,继续寻找海鲜灵感。他教授了如何安排一场独一无二海鲜盛宴的大师班。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #6
programme.desc: 廖崇明从新加坡动物园的传统早餐,包括咖央多士、温泉蛋和咖啡开始,寻找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #7
programme.desc: 为了寻找最适合国宴的食材,廖崇明到访色彩缤纷的芽笼蔬果市场以及米芝莲星级餐厅。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #8
programme.desc: 在鸡尾酒会期间,从峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精致的甜品吧,廖崇明发现了一些新加坡最好的甜品。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #9
programme.desc: 廖崇明把过去几周所学到的知识融汇贯通,为包括他母亲在内的一些贵客提供令人印象深刻的五道菜晚宴。

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy

programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.desc: Huang Yunong's Yunong Reptile Studio has an extraordinary passion for geckos and he regards every gecko as his own He always feel sad when consumers buy them, just like saying goodbye to his own child He always shares care knowledge in great detail, and cultivates concepts through his own experience to let more people know more about hem He hopes that through "Cute Pets Coming

programme.title: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: Each year, hundreds of critically endangered manatees are killed in US waters by boats, disease and cold weather 2006 was the worst year on record for manatee deaths – 416 animals perished With only a few thousand remaining in the wild, mostly in heavily developed Florida wetlands, the clock is ticking in efforts to save this amazing mammal from extinction

programme.title: Shark Gordon
programme.desc: It has been believed that shark attacks are a result of mistaken identity; sharks mistake humans for other fish But can sharks really not tell the difference?

programme.title: 塞斯梅耶斯深夜秀 13 #60
programme.desc: 《塞斯梅耶斯深夜秀》由艾美奖得主洛恩米高斯监制,邀请一线红星作嘉宾,还有难忘的喜剧和最棒的音乐人。

programme.title: 吉米法伦今夜秀 13 #61
programme.desc: 艾美奖及格林美奖得主兼喜剧演员吉米法伦以好客的访问风格、观众投入度、精准的模仿和创新的短剧,将他独特的高能爆笑喜剧引进NBC的60年传奇系列。

programme.title: 47浪人
programme.desc: 基努李维主演《47浪人》,这是一部史诗奇幻电影,讲述一名被放逐的浪人加入武士行列,为了对抗残暴的领主、寻求复仇与荣耀,在古代日本展开惊心动魄的旅程。

programme.title: 迈阿密风云
programme.desc: 在《迈阿密风云》中,由杰米・福克斯与柯林・法洛饰演的卧底警探深入毒品世界,在危险、诱惑与犯罪中周旋。这部风格鲜明、紧张刺激的作品重新演绎经典影集,同时由巩俐联袂主演。

programme.title: 玩命对战
programme.desc: 在他的搭档汤姆韦恩和家人被臭名昭彰且难以捉摸的刺客罗格(李连杰)杀害后,联邦调查局特工约翰克劳佛(杰森斯坦森)开始沉迷于报复,因为他的世界陷入了内疚和背叛的漩涡。

programme.title: 铁拳无敌

programme.title: 地中海游艇 10 #1

programme.title: 地中海游艇 10 #3

programme.title: 地中海游艇 10 #5

programme.title: 功夫
programme.desc: 由亚洲顶尖喜剧明星周星驰主演的功夫,是他继2001年轰动一时的少林足球之后备受期待的续作故事背景设定于革命前的中国乱世,落魄的阿星(周星驰饰)渴望提升地位,寻求加入彪悍而残酷的斧头帮阿星在贫民窟猪笼城寨企图勒索居民时,他可笑的恐吓举动却意外引来斧头帮介入由此,猪笼城寨的居民不得不为生存而战,更揭示出当中的隐世武林高手现在阿星必须直视死亡,才能领悟真正的武学宗师之道

programme.desc: 本片讲述一对布鲁克林水管工的故事--玛利欧与路易吉,他们既是兄弟,也是最好的朋友勇敢的玛利欧总是抱著去吧!的精神;而路易吉则常年焦虑,较喜欢哪里都不去故事开场,超级玛利欧兄弟的水管生意欠佳,并意外卷入蘑菇王国的奇幻冒险在旅程中,我们遇见一群熟悉又可爱的角色,最终还携手对抗渴望权力的反派库巴超级玛利欧兄弟大电影把全球千万玩家35年来的所爱提升至全新境界,化为令人屏息的电影体验

programme.title: 卧虎藏龙
programme.desc: 本片是一部充满华丽画面与极具诗意动作的武侠电影李安荣获奥斯卡的电影卧虎藏龙,以史诗式爱情故事为主轴,同时交织著背叛与对权力的欲望周润发(安娜与国王)饰演传奇武侠李慕白,他把名剑青冥剑交予昔日恋人俞秀莲(杨紫琼饰,新铁金刚之明日帝国),托付她送至京城然而,玉剑遭窃,嫌疑落到恶名昭彰的逃犯碧眼狐狸(郑佩佩饰)身上,她杀死李慕白的师父,并暗中伪装成提督爱女玉娇龙(章子怡饰)的狡诈师娘在碧眼狐狸的影响下,玉娇龙拒绝按父母之命成婚,更化身成如猫般敏捷的蒙面女侠然而,她投身江湖的过程,却因旧爱罗

programme.title: 中年新手警察 (第八季) #7
programme.desc: 约翰诺兰是洛杉矶警局最年长的新手警员,他凭借人生经验,决心与幽默感,努力跟上其他比他年轻20岁的新人随著训练即将结束,诺兰面临作为警员最大的挑战--他必须正视自己在追求真相过程中所作的选择

programme.title: 联邦调查局-国际刑警 (第四季) #7
programme.desc: 卫斯的旧同事泰勒布夫向飞行小队求助

programme.title: 超级玛利欧兄弟大电影
programme.desc: 本片讲述一对布鲁克林水管工的故事--玛利欧与路易吉,他们既是兄弟,也是最好的朋友勇敢的玛利欧总是抱著去吧!的精神;而路易吉则常年焦虑,较喜欢哪里都不去故事开场,超级玛利欧兄弟的水管生意欠佳,并意外卷入蘑菇王国的奇幻冒险在旅程中,我们遇见一群熟悉又可爱的角色,最终还携手对抗渴望权力的反派库巴超级玛利欧兄弟大电影把全球千万玩家35年来的所爱提升至全新境界,化为令人屏息的电影体验

programme.title: 功夫
programme.desc: 由亚洲顶尖喜剧明星周星驰主演的功夫,是他继2001年轰动一时的少林足球之后备受期待的续作故事背景设定于革命前的中国乱世,落魄的阿星(周星驰饰)渴望提升地位,寻求加入彪悍而残酷的斧头帮阿星在贫民窟猪笼城寨企图勒索居民时,他可笑的恐吓举动却意外引来斧头帮介入由此,猪笼城寨的居民不得不为生存而战,更揭示出当中的隐世武林高手现在阿星必须直视死亡,才能领悟真正的武学宗师之道

programme.title: 美国忍者王 (第十五季) #6
programme.desc: 资格赛继续在洛杉矶进行,来自全国各地的参赛者将参加世界上最具挑战性的障碍赛年仅15岁的参赛者将重返赛场与老将对决,并有机会挑战更高的巨型曲面墙

programme.title: 看不见的罪案(第一季) #7
programme.desc: 积(丹尼尔吉利斯饰)和德丝(多莉路易斯饰)正在调查一名货车司机被枪杀的案件,扫黄组突然出现,要求他们放走头号疑犯,以免破坏扫黄组的调查该疑犯被发现死于审讯室后,两队人马皆遭到怀疑,警局更被封锁起来,但积与德丝必须把握时间尽快破案积的性命受威胁,而德丝又因为辛妮(阿加达西饰)的大厦停电而与她中断了联系,导致情势急转直下与此同时,嘉尔(恩尼斯艾斯默饰)与辛妮的关系逐渐加深,直至辛妮偷听到一通可疑的电话

programme.title: 特警雄风 (第八季) #17

programme.title: 无名记忆 (第2季) #19
programme.desc: 一直对法尔萨斯造成威胁的幕后黑手瓦尔托掳走了缇娜夏,要她协助取得红色与蓝色的魔法球「艾尔特利亚」。缇娜夏对凑齐魔法球的后果也不清楚。诅咒奥斯卡的沉默魔女菈碧妮亚在法尔萨斯城现身,揭开了自己是奥斯卡祖母的事实,以及他母亲萝莎莉亚死去的真相。

programme.title: 无名记忆 (第2季) #20

你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地的见证人,100篇令人万万想不到的剧本,配以崭新的拍摄和剪接手法,滋润都市人的心灵,带来生命的觉醒。

programme.title: 如果还有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面对著生命中突然而至的苦难与罪困,在天灾、人祸、病困及罪咎中,有人因为痛苦不堪而选择轻生,但亦都有人在挣扎过后,生命变得更有焦点,更清晰人生的方向。影音使团制作队跨越中港台两地,拍摄对象包括:台湾风灾救灾者、饱历风霜的一代影星、蒙古车祸生还者、从死亡边缘活过来的反派演员、与癌同行的历奇教练等。藉著十个见证者的亲身经历,让观众明白他们如何靠著基督信仰跨过生命中最难熬过的难关。

programme.title: 《天下华人唱出好诗歌大赛》大赛
programme.desc: 由影音使团、香港福音盛会、华福会香港区委会、以勒基金主办,创世电视首届「天下华人唱出好诗歌」大赛,冠军即将诞生。世上最美的声音,是生命重生的声音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位参加者,一年训练、成长、比并、同行,要成为祝福城市的好声音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地的见证人,100篇令人万万想不到的剧本,配以崭新的拍摄和剪接手法,滋润都市人的心灵,带来生命的觉醒。

programme.title: 如果还有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面对著生命中突然而至的苦难与罪困,在天灾、人祸、病困及罪咎中,有人因为痛苦不堪而选择轻生,但亦都有人在挣扎过后,生命变得更有焦点,更清晰人生的方向。影音使团制作队跨越中港台两地,拍摄对象包括:台湾风灾救灾者、饱历风霜的一代影星、蒙古车祸生还者、从死亡边缘活过来的反派演员、与癌同行的历奇教练等。藉著十个见证者的亲身经历,让观众明白他们如何靠著基督信仰跨过生命中最难熬过的难关。

programme.title: 葛培理牧师特辑
programme.desc: 节目记录葛培理布道团最新福音事工,并葛培理牧师70年来布道的足迹及对世界各地的贡献,让我们面对不同的世情,仍然把握机会传福音。

programme.title: 圣地流动教室-以色列破谜之旅
programme.desc: 通晓中西方历史、文学、艺术、民间传说的学者吴宗文牧师,以及主持梁艺龄,透过镜头带著电视观众,去到圣地各站游历,呈现出新旧约的《圣经》典故、历史文献的记载、相关的犹太传说和传统习俗,而更重要是从耶稣和初期信徒的记载,带出人生的重要特质,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 属灵教室: 王良牧牧师- 神迹医治

programme.title: 福音电影: 天地孩儿
programme.desc: 新生儿科权威余宇熙教授,为墨尔本Monash Medical Centre新生儿科部的主管二十多年。三十年来在新生儿科不断研究中,余教授多次突破拯救早产婴儿的限制,将抢救期由廿八周前至廿三周,成就显赫,为华人在西方医学界中带来震撼。余教授积极联系澳洲维多利亚省内四间新生儿科深切治疗部,组织一个完善拯救早产婴儿的交通系统(Newborn Emergency Transport Service,简称 NETS)。在短短三年间,一共协助抢救了5437名初生及早产婴儿。

programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面对著生命中突然而至的苦难与罪困,在天灾、人祸、病困及罪咎中,有人因为痛苦不堪而选择轻生,但亦都有人在挣扎过后,生命变得更有焦点,更清晰人生的方向。影音使团制作队跨越中港台两地,拍摄对象包括:台湾风灾救灾者、饱历风霜的一代影星、蒙古车祸生还者、从死亡边缘活过来的反派演员、与癌同行的历奇教练等。藉著十个见证者的亲身经历,让观众明白他们如何靠著基督信仰跨过生命中最难熬过的难关。

programme.title: 主日讲坛-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 讲题:再苦也要笑一笑 人每一天都要面对很多抉择,要将上帝的智慧应用在生活不同层面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧师和传道人的讲道中,往往都能够得到启迪。透过主日讲坛,更明白神的道并在生活中寻求到神喜悦的心意。

programme.title: 灵修早晨

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 铁证待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之铁证待判》继续以游历的方式,走进荷兰、土耳其、约旦、敍利亚,涉及接近50个地点,超过30个已经发生嘅神迹预言、传奇故事,以考古和实证,重新解构连科学都不能解释的千古谜团。 历年来有无数的考古学家和世界知名的纪录片频道,为了解开上帝藉著摩西施行神迹分割红海这个历史迷团,他们都不惜花上大量的财力物力,研发新科技,要到红海的海底寻找历史证据。这集创世电视会直撀约旦,踏足每一处地方,搜罗各种铁证,带你经历摩西如何施行神迹分割红海,从埃及法老王手中,带领以色列人平安走过红海,离开埃及。

programme.desc: 乔峰决定跟众人以干杯绝交，往日旧情一笔勾销，谁杀死谁都不算忘恩负义；乔峰拜托白世镜好好照顾阿朱，白世镜随即答应；在乔峰被围攻之际，一名黑衣人突然救走他；乔峰决定到雁门关查明身世，也势要找出带头大哥…

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
鼎爷做节攻略粤
programme.desc: 宴客菜要讲体面，鼎爷率先带来「甫鱼刺参扒鹅掌」。甫鱼又名大地鱼、方鱼，将甫鱼干以明火烘香后，配上鲮鱼骨等食材制成鲜味汤胆；雪藏鹅掌经过汆水、油炸、蒸煮，再与海参同焖，置碟后淋上蚝油芡，撒上虾子，卖相得体。过节美食亦讲意头，不妨来一道「家乡咸汤圆」。留意鼎爷示范搓粉团技巧，怎样可令汤圆不易裂开？用虾米、冬菇等材料煮汤底，汤圆则裹入鲮鱼肉、虾米碎。细尝大大粒汤圆配丰富汤料，渗出与别不同的家乡味道。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 《流行都市》跟观众同迎马年，并邀得苏民峰带来马年运程预测，新一年有甚么行业特别畅旺？师傅提醒要注意正南及西北是病位；财位、桃花位又在何方？胡仔、美妮、永浩、秀怡随李文星师傅觅食，到私房菜餐厅享用「厨师发办」团年饭。以「捞起」作序，兼有金蚝、鲍鱼、东星斑、猪手等做主角的各款意头菜式，众人于席间亦谈到家乡过年习俗。「睇𩠌食饭」，陈国宾用三款鱼材炮制团年菜「年年有余庆团圆」，当中还有意想不到的汤圆馅料。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在广州粤
programme.desc: 广州，粤菜发源地之一，广府菜的中心，是每一位食客都无法拒绝的美食圣地。爱吃爱玩的主持人麦包，在广州彻底释放了吃货天性，走遍大街小巷，寻找地道美食：悠闲早茶、西关小吃、新潮佳馔，夜市小摊

programme.title: 单恋双城#12粤
programme.desc: 慕雪入院，要恭梓回港探望。式适回旅行社工作，云锋故意牵连式适背上黑镬。展禛知钱进为了式适忍了二十年没吃榴梿，得到启发用榴梿做甜品参赛。慕雪出院后要交食评稿，恭梓提议由他代笔，他又到优越旅游任营运主任。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子和爸爸结伴去新年参拜，途中却遇到诸多阻挠，令他们一再延误，疲于奔命。爸爸坚称鬼怪只在夏天出没，小丸子则以灵异书籍为证作出反驳，回到学校，小丸子和藤木等人尝试印证鬼怪是否存在。

programme.title: 灼热卡巴迪粤日
programme.desc: 宵越龙哉曾是成绩亮丽的足球学界选手。然而，当他升上高中，便趁机与体育切断关系。卡巴迪队为招揽宵越加入，不但派畦道拉他到场参观，副队长井浦更设计要胁，逼使宵越体验卡巴迪这项冷门运动。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 农历新年前后，有不少传统习俗，小朋友又认识几多？「Kids’ Notes」请来萧欣浩博士讲述相关故事与宜忌。年廿八大扫除，寓意洗走过去一年的家中污垢，但到初一就不宜扫地？虽然现代社会较少提起守岁，但不少家庭却「不知就里」地做到？谢灶又是一项怎样的传统习俗？团年饭、开年饭都甚少吃粥，原来是一种禁忌，信不信由你。庙宇香火鼎盛，大众为祈福而争先恐后上头炷香；旧时新年还会藉烧炮竹来制造声响，并吓走年兽。

programme.title: 多啦A梦粤
programme.desc: 多啦Ａ梦正在发著美梦，却被来救助的大雄吵醒。大雄为了令多啦Ａ梦息怒，答应请吃豆沙包。小夫邀请大雄等人来家中，聆听昆虫的叫声。但之后小夫表示，若想继续听就要付费，令众人十分不满。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.desc: 楼市升温，投资者也加快入市，元朗有入伙盘出现多宗短炒，赚幅普遍有多大？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 世界观粤 及 天气报告粤
东张西望粤
programme.desc: 农历年廿九，不少市民到维园行花市并选购年货。何沛珈、王嘉慧等《东张西望》主持「落区」拍摄贺岁节目，了解市民吃团年饭的情况。有居民因家中铝窗遭污水腐蚀「报东张」，事主亦曾求助渗水办，却未获妥善处理。摄制队安排验楼师到场检测，发现渗水严重更疑似含有尿液成分。验楼师再协助追查源头，怀疑与对上两层单位的改建有关，但该单位却已放售……黄子华、郑秀文为主演电影宣传，在闹市大派利是。另介绍澳门的新春打卡好去处。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2746粤
programme.desc: 璟风听到敢威打算邀请瑞素一起吃团年饭，却发现他另有安排。瑞素告诉璟风，她会与熊家众人团年，但最终因故未能参与。大除夕当天，瑞素原本有路小小等人陪伴，她们却因不同原因先行离去。后来，璟风得知瑞素并未与熊家众人团年，遂致电瑞素。瑞素谎称在鲸吞天厦与小小等人开派对，璟风前往找瑞素，却遭李莫仇纠缠，为避开她而躲进一部由莫仇改造的特别仪器。其间，璟风似乎发了一个疑幻似真的梦，仿佛遇见年幼时的瑞素……

programme.title: 非常检控观#21粤PG
programme.desc: 湘言被泰巨掳走，希仁、善昱找庞喆救人；其后，湘言终于找到晶晶……庞喆提供泰巨承认经营性招待、人口贩卖的罪证。逸桐将泰巨潜逃的消息告知熊飞，熊飞感激。湘言相信庞喆清白，熊飞却查出他助泰巨潜逃，希仁更知悉基金会资助儿童院舍的真正目的，劝湘言莫被庞喆蒙骗。泰巨落网得知被庞喆出卖，决心指证他！庞喆涉嫌行贿被捕，善昱设法营救。庞喆因特殊考量未被提控，希仁不满颂星的指令。希仁向传媒公开庞喆罪状，并宣布辞职！

programme.title: 欢乐茶饭#13粤普PG
programme.desc: 韶光结识曾与林晏说亲的景文，沈家人发觉景文是祖宗；柳丰品尝小饭馆暖锅，与韶光相谈甚欢，更邀韶光合作开店，韶光见林晏与景文相处感难受；林晏向长公主套问驸马尺牍下落，得知柳翁为柳丰向韶光提亲便赶到小饭馆…

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

骏马迎春贺新岁粤
programme.desc: 多位星级艺人齐齐送旧迎新接福气，送走蛇年，迎接马年！玄学师傅亲授马年开运攻略，让观众掌握流年先机。「东张女神」亲访酒楼，带来亲朋好友围吃团年饭的实况；《爱．回家之开心速递》众演员畅玩游戏，以笑声欢度新禧。主持谭俊彦、陈庭欣、孔德贤、林秀怡跟大家一起从年廿九倒数到大年初一，与全城同贺新春。「财神爷」更会大派吉祥利是，向市民送上满满的财运和祝福，共度热闹欢腾跨年夜，迎来骏马奔腾的新一年！

programme.title: 呖咕呖咕新年财粤PG
programme.desc: 麻雀大侠德华天生喜爱打麻雀，以致多年前债台高筑连累家庭，与弟弟天乐反目成仇。此时天乐经济上出现困难，德华决负起责任，并以麻雀治疗患上老人痴呆症的母亲，惟时遭旧女友咏琪百般纠缠，不胜其烦。天乐坚持要靠自己，找工作时却堕进麻雀老千采儿及青云设下的陷阱，财产给洗劫一空。德华为弟报仇，力战青云大胜。时隆胸后的咏琪再次向德华示爱，但遭到拒绝，一怒之下诅咒德华「一世摸烂牌」。不料咏琪下的咒语竟然生效，德华连场败北，家财一赌而尽……

programme.title: Gi味俱全粤
programme.desc: 本集Gigi姐会用太极猪做五香一字排，这种猪肉肥瘦均称、肉质佳。Gigi姐曾在温哥华用这道菜式宴请四哥谢贤，四哥尝过后觉得它很适合用来下酒，并认为能够拯救他的酒吧。Gigi姐亦会教大家一个腌肉的诀窍。

programme.title: 万千星辉贺台庆粤
programme.desc: TVB「同心同行 闯新世代」，度过第58个璀灿年华，寓意于AI新时代继续与观众并肩前行，跨步未来。台庆盛典由「阿姐」汪明荃带领林盛斌、朱凯婷，以及龚嘉欣、陈晓华等担纲司仪，召集众多艺人一同庆贺TVB生辰。阿姐、胡枫客串时装模特儿；陈豪、谭俊彦携后辈艺员「薪火对话」；谢天华率陈咏诗等全女班舞动热力；「好声音」联乘「声梦」唱演音乐剧；福禄寿连结女神配对计划「扮嘢」演出，幕幕精彩。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈献：丙午年吉星高照年初一粤
programme.desc: 丙午马年，TVB上下一心恭贺年初一。《中年好声音》比拼「翻杯过三关」，热唱贺年歌。森美、Eric Kwok与Plan V分成两组挑战《唱钱》，注入喜庆节奏。《Hands Up》姐姐引领小朋友「摘彩头」，赢骏马公仔。《J Music》联乘「声秀」唱将欢颂<四喜临门喜迎春；三姐助阵《流行都市》，教煮应节小食，众人还抽「幸运星」迎春接福。阿姐靓声贺岁、胡枫化身「财神」派利是，加上醒狮献瑞，齐心送祝福！

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 大年初一，《流行都市》一众主持与苏民峰师傅向观众拜年。苏师傅还带来肖马、肖羊、肖猴人士，在马年的事业、爱情与健康运程预测。本命年属马者犯太岁，要特别留意甚么？大王带芝龄、菲比、芷伦，以及于围村长大的吴大强一同新春行大运，走入元朗跟邓达智拜年，并感受围村舞狮贺岁的热闹气氛。达智款待众人在祠堂享用围村贺年素食宴席，并介绍菜式的吉祥寓意。「睇𩠌食饭」，三姐呈献素菜「袋袋黄金迎新岁」，祝大家马年财源滚滚！

programme.title: 中年好声音3红白大战粤
programme.desc: 支喾仪、谭辉智分别率领男、女子组上演红白大战。王郑浚仁并肩李创伟带来<左邻右里，对垒有「特别人马」助战的陈芷盈、阮慧珊<心急人上。接着，浚仁再上阵伙拍刘洋、占士丁丁高唱激励英文歌；善玥澄、曹越等女子组同诉<给自己的情书。魔王级刘洋、陈芷盈、张与辰、黄博轮流登场独唱，挑战高难度曲目<浮夸、<梦中人、<饿狼传说、<陀飞轮。同场加映，李金凯、赵浚承会跳唱于登峰之战未有机会表演的决胜快歌。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 藤木弄丢了压岁钱，原来被阿山捡到，更花了小部分请爸爸喝酒，小丸子要求爸爸把钱归还。小丸子刨笔刨到心烦，恰巧见到姐姐有别人送的铅芯笔，好生羡慕，爷爷于是替她把用短了的铅笔黏合起来。

programme.title: 灼热卡巴迪粤日
programme.desc: 宵越拒绝参加防守方的训练，理由是俗称「锁链」的防守阵形，需要跟同性队员手牵手。可是，在进攻训练中，宵越却又屡尝败绩。为找出突破口，宵越决定细心观察他的队员，终于想出了必胜法，更宣言要完成帽子戏法。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 适逢农历大年初一的喜庆日子，「My Little Show」舞台上亦响起贺年乐韵。十三位小朋友以童声童气大合唱<祝福你，为观众送上满满的新春祝福。接着有女生以古筝弹奏<凤阳花鼓，延续喜气。波波姐姐再次亮相节目，与一众主持姐姐齐声唱儿歌。这次她们特意配合农历新年主题，唱出《亲戚歌》、《欢乐年年》，唤起大家拜年、团聚的美好回忆。此外，波波姐姐亦会细谈音乐中的大调、小调分别。

programme.title: 忍者乱太郎粤日
programme.desc: 小丸掉下的铜钱滚了下山。小丸为了找回铜钱一直追到去毒菇忍者的据点。乱太郎他们抵达兵库水军的据点时，遇到一个样貌与第三协荣丸相同的人。金吾遵从户部老师的建议，前往观看剑豪的斗瞪眼比拼。

programme.desc: 心房颤动是心律不正的一种，因心房不规则地跳动，心脏无法有效地将血液泵送至心室，导致心跳加速且不规律，症状包括心悸、气喘等，可引发许多健康问题，严重时甚至会增加中风风险。除了定期进行心脏检查，养成健康的生活习惯都是预防心房颤动的重要一环。

programme.title: 2026国泰新春国际汇演之夜粤
programme.desc: 大年初一晚上，尖沙咀上演年度新春国际汇演，与广大市民欢贺新岁！本届盛会以「开年 开运 开心」为主题，十二辆融入骏马与新春特色的花车耀目登场。来自本港、内地与世界各地的表演团队参与巡游，呈现英歌舞、战旗杂技、活力啦啦队、光影梦幻白马、巨型彩色恐龙等多元文化魅力。歌手陈奂仁也会领衔「中年、声梦、声秀」唱将献声助兴。主持陆浩明、朱凯婷引领观众感受庆典狂热，曾展望、叶蒨文亦直击喜气洋洋的街头巡游气氛。

programme.title: 新春保良迎金马粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 宋宛颖、关嘉敏等以女团姿态跳唱<恭喜发财，施宇琪与袁文静藉古筝、说唱表演和应。草蜢送上<华丽舞台贺马年，并带来新作<老的辣。布志纶祝大家<行得走得；周吉佩、张与辰合作传递新春喜悦，陈咏诗舞动丝带助兴；还有林奕匡、黄妍等献声支持保良局。马德钟、赖慰玲领军大玩贺年版「以讹传讹」游戏，发放欢乐。吴若希、戴祖仪等艺人则外访介绍机构的贴心支援服务。陈松伶压轴登场献唱新歌<松伶，为节目划上温馨句号。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#1粤
programme.desc: 项少龙等特警负责秦俑展览会的保安，同僚发现其中一秦俑的样貌跟少龙相似。富商李小超为展览会剪彩，有狂徒扮记者混入，并以满身炸药挟持小超及少龙的公关女友秦青，幸少龙机智制服狂徒。秦青责少龙七年来一直逃避不结婚，向他发最后通牒。小超游说少龙参与穿梭时空实验，少龙拒绝。少龙欲向秦青求婚，但秦青已赴外国结婚，为了让时光倒流挽回秦青的心，答应跟小超合作。少龙坐时空穿梭机向秦朝出发，清醒时发现大批军马向他冲来。

programme.title: 康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#2粤
programme.desc: 杀手善柔与人生死搏斗时，少龙从天而降救善柔一命。少龙知道身处赵国，请善柔带他到秦都咸阳，以便回到现代。善柔却带他到邯郸的武士行馆投宿，少龙跟踪善柔，期间听到严平一众正密谋毒杀元宗。少龙惊悉善柔是女儿身。善柔与少龙见到一老者遭流浪剑客欺负，仗义出手，善柔推断他是元宗。严平欲以毒酒毒杀元宗，少龙与善柔及时相救。元宗是「墨者行会」传人，严平欲夺其「钜子令」号令会众。元宗答应教少龙墨子剑法，严平突然寻至。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 大年初一，《流行都市》一众主持与苏民峰师傅向观众拜年。苏师傅还带来肖马、肖羊、肖猴人士，在马年的事业、爱情与健康运程预测。本命年属马者犯太岁，要特别留意甚么？大王带芝龄、菲比、芷伦，以及于围村长大的吴大强一同新春行大运，走入元朗跟邓达智拜年，并感受围村舞狮贺岁的热闹气氛。达智款待众人在祠堂享用围村贺年素食宴席，并介绍菜式的吉祥寓意。「睇𩠌食饭」，三姐呈献素菜「袋袋黄金迎新岁」，祝大家马年财源滚滚！

programme.title: 鼎爷做节攻略粤
programme.desc: 宴客菜要讲体面，鼎爷率先带来「甫鱼刺参扒鹅掌」。甫鱼又名大地鱼、方鱼，将甫鱼干以明火烘香后，配上鲮鱼骨等食材制成鲜味汤胆；雪藏鹅掌经过汆水、油炸、蒸煮，再与海参同焖，置碟后淋上蚝油芡，撒上虾子，卖相得体。过节美食亦讲意头，不妨来一道「家乡咸汤圆」。留意鼎爷示范搓粉团技巧，怎样可令汤圆不易裂开？用虾米、冬菇等材料煮汤底，汤圆则裹入鲮鱼肉、虾米碎。细尝大大粒汤圆配丰富汤料，渗出与别不同的家乡味道。

programme.title: 中年好声音3红白大战粤
programme.desc: 支喾仪、谭辉智分别率领男、女子组上演红白大战。王郑浚仁并肩李创伟带来<左邻右里，对垒有「特别人马」助战的陈芷盈、阮慧珊<心急人上。接着，浚仁再上阵伙拍刘洋、占士丁丁高唱激励英文歌；善玥澄、曹越等女子组同诉<给自己的情书。魔王级刘洋、陈芷盈、张与辰、黄博轮流登场独唱，挑战高难度曲目<浮夸、<梦中人、<饿狼传说、<陀飞轮。同场加映，李金凯、赵浚承会跳唱于登峰之战未有机会表演的决胜快歌。

programme.title: 家家行运菜粤
programme.desc: 围村人的「派门头」，竟是分享添丁喜悦的独特方法？王君馨、吴业坤和麦长青向围村居民贺嫂和贺叔偷师炮制两道贺年菜— 寓意添丁发财的「茨菰炆猪肉」和长命百岁的「粉丝虾米黄芽白」，吃过这些好意头的围村贺年菜，马年定会事事顺利！「行运嘉宾」高钧贤和陈智燊两位在外国长大的型男主厨，分别带来中西合璧的「富贵齐来」和「招财金菠萝」。主持还请来宋熙年到来畅谈在外国过年的难忘事。「迎新年八件事」主持介绍多款特色水果。

programme.title: 家家行运菜粤
programme.desc: 所谓「民以吃为天」，若能在农历新年期间，品尝到不同的传统菜式，绝对是迎新岁的最好方法！主持麦长青、王君馨和吴业坤马年率先「驿马星动」，为大家穿梭全港各区屋邨、渔村、围村、农村等地方，就每集主题如头盘、海鲜、家禽、炖汤、甜点等，向各家各户「取经」，拆解不同家庭的美味贺年菜式的秘密，让你在新年先行吃运，大饱口福！此外，每集主持还会请来「行运」嘉宾炮制「自家贺年菜」，与大家分享他们独门的烹调秘诀！

programme.title: 万千星辉颁奖典礼2025粤
programme.desc: 《新闻女王2》横扫九个奖项，成2025台庆颁奖礼大赢家。除了囊括香港、大湾区两个剧集奖项，佘诗曼、黄宗泽同封「双料视帝、视后」。何广沛、王敏奕首夺「最佳男、女配角」，由詹天文主唱的电视歌曲亦得奖。「最佳男、女主持」方面，车婉婉爆喊当选，林盛斌激动领奖震撼全场！吴业坤、叶蒨文成功「飞跃」，「男、女新人」则落在冯皓扬、刘洋、倪嘉雯手里。曾志伟荣膺「万千光辉荣誉传奇」，获谭咏麟现身颁奖兼献歌，场面动人！

programme.title: 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
programme.desc: 选择大湾区安老院舍除了考虑环境和服务，交通及生活配套亦非常重要。今集主持徐荣介绍的一所六星级康养中心，直通巴士站、商场、食肆都近在咫尺，让长者能够享受精彩充实的安老生活。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 苏民峰师傅继续细谈马年生肖运程，属鸡者是好运榜首？狗是重桃花的生肖，但同时要慎防六粒凶星！属猪人士将「表明风光，地位提升」，是好还是坏？年初二，桃李满门的低音大提琴导师，找来四名学生合作演奏中国民谣<凤阳花鼓；其中两位还是其公子，从小就习琴。要学好低音大提琴，时间管理最重要！众学生还分享学习得着，以及出外表演的深刻点滴。「睇𩠌食饭」，潮州菜师傅许美德以龙虾及马蹄，示范贺年菜「龙马精神」。

programme.title: 中年好声音3红白大战粤
programme.desc: 下半场先来「国风对决」，曹越、刘晓昆、陈嘉琦的<糖不甩，穿上戏曲服饰的赵浚承、陆东成等以<新禅院钟声应战。紧接是「四王四后」比拼，两队各派四人模仿九十年代天王、天后，星味十足。善玥澄、刘晓昆、阮慧珊、侯静伊、钟凯莹化身性感女团送上<似火探戈和<烈焰红唇，这场「热舞激战」白队会如何应对？终极回合的「梦想解码」，两队会合力演绎动人舞台剧。另外，陈芷盈、占士丁丁会带来为登峰之战准备的决胜快歌。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子得知中野先生家里冷清，适逢节分来临，便偕同爷爷跑到对方家为其撒豆驱鬼、迎春接福。小丸子为了丰富茶点，决定暂时不用被炉，爷爷带小丸子到房里用火钵取暖煎茶，让她认识到火钵的魅力。

programme.title: 灼热卡巴迪粤日
programme.desc: 宵越和畦道的一年级队，与水澄和伊达的二年级队进行练习比赛，却以大比数差距惨败。虽然宵越对合作感到抗拒，但他深知如要获胜，就必须与畦道建立团队默契。宵越与畦道继而展开秘密特训，向二年级队提出挑战！

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 过农历新年时，总会见到萝卜糕、芋头糕等糕点，原来与同音字「高」有关，寓意地位提升。至于拜年常见的攒盒(全盒)，为何会放入油炸食物及糖渍食物？每一件放进去的东西，即使是不能吃的利是和桔，都别有寓意！对本地文化甚有研究的萧欣浩博士逐一讲解。春节传统习俗上，初三会拜神祈福，初七会庆祝「人日」，背后可有甚么故事？年十五「元宵」亦被称为「中国情人节」，古时男女相聚花灯会互表心意，也会吃象征甜蜜团圆的汤圆。

programme.title: 忍者乱太郎粤日
programme.desc: 雪鬼和雨鬼被其他城堡的忍者招揽过档。新丁出奇地在测验中取得全班最高的分数，但新丁自己也不明白为什么会有这样的成绩。乱太郎他们走捷径返回忍术学校，途中意外发现了一间大屋及形迹可疑的人。

programme.title: 香港赛马会呈献:「马到功成耀香江」马年烟花汇演粤
programme.desc: 2026马年烟花汇演于大年初二(1月18日)晚上八时，在维多利亚港上空举行。本年新春烟花汇演主题是「马到功成耀香江」，共分八幕，总共发放31,888枚烟花。除了首幕《骏马启程》有15秒高密度开幕烟花与礼花弹层层推进，营造骏马初出、万马奔腾的形象之外，历时23分钟的汇演还可看到「8」字型、金元宝图案、星光、大锦冠的耀目烟花效果。节目直击烟花璀璨的盛况，和香港民众一起感受春节热闹气氛，共同欢度新岁。

programme.title: 非常检控观#22粤PG
programme.desc: 希仁获挽留，得以检控庞喆，颂星引咎辞职。庞喆设法自救，讵料……子廉猝逝，其父赵德贤的前妻李妃宸携子赵子礼回来，认回德贤。子礼行山失踪，后被发现尸体，熊飞展开调查。善昱取得庞喆的股权，有意成为集团主席的接任人。妃宸告知希仁与熊飞，子礼与她及德贤竟无血缘关系，怀疑当年人工受孕过程中出错！子帧被要求过继给德贤，以成为集团继承人，他惊觉德敬并非全无野心，担心德敬为让他成为接班人而犯错，公孙珀劝他查明真相。

programme.title: 欢乐茶饭#14粤普PG
programme.desc: 韶光拒绝了柳丰的求亲；韶光向林晏提及关于洗碗机的事，没想到他竟然真的造了出来；林晏使计令长公主交出尺牍，亦让赵王发现林晏开始对自己起疑；林晏打算为崔家平反后，就向韶光提亲；沈家迎来在永安的第一场雪…

programme.title: 香港欧化飞鹰活络油呈献：一马当先行大运粤
programme.desc: 大年初二，玲玲师傅相约洪天明、周家蔚夫妇同吃开年饭。天明细谈父亲洪金宝坚持传统礼节，晚辈要向长辈跪拜敬茶贺年，并透露父亲望添一名孙女，遂向师傅探问玄机。碧霞师傅称家中门口忌放雨伞、鞋等，即使挥春亦只宜贴至正月十五？丞丞师傅与展望、蒨文新春行大运游览佛山三水，了解魁岗文塔的历史及风水故事，还尝试用葱、芹、粽子祈福的当地习俗。云文子师傅带来2026年猫狗催运贴士；还有元海伉俪送上马年家居旺位布阵锦囊。

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 天气报告粤 及 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#3粤
programme.desc: 元宗与严平两败俱伤，善柔杀严平取其头胪领赏金。元宗临终送木剑及钜子令给少龙。少龙责善柔见利忘义害死元宗，愤然离去。少龙误打误撞助灰胡擒乌氏家将陶方及大小姐乌廷芳，原来灰胡是马贼及受雇夺取和氏璧，少龙使计助陶方及廷芳逃走，得知和氏璧用来交换秦质子嬴政，答应替陶方取回。灰胡的雇主取得和氏璧后杀人灭口，陶方推测此人是赵国巨鹿侯赵穆的手下连晋，二人跟踪连晋，惊见他打造假和氏璧及杀工匠灭口。

programme.title: 康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#4粤
programme.desc: 少龙见连晋欲私吞和氏璧，使计将真假和氏璧调包。陶方带少龙回乌家堡拜会主人乌应元，廷芳不满少龙诋毁连晋。连晋将假和氏璧交给赵穆，少龙在赵王面前略施小计即令乌家脱罪，赵穆暗气。少龙不值王妹赵雅之子赵盘欺负少女，仗义教训之。少龙随应元入宫饮宴，被一美宫女吸引。原来她是廷芳好友公主赵倩。赵穆与少龙、应元为应否放嬴政母子返秦争拗，赵穆乘机怂恿少龙与连晋在御前比剑，连晋应战挥剑劈向少龙的脑门。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粤
programme.desc: 斋是农历新年的常见菜式，本集Gigi姐会示范烹煮现代版本，例如以前的斋是有发菜的，但现在因为保护环境而不会再用。而传统的斋总给人油腻的感觉，Gigi姐教大家挑选比较健康又耐热的油，最适合用来做这道斋。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 苏民峰师傅继续细谈马年生肖运程，属鸡者是好运榜首？狗是重桃花的生肖，但同时要慎防六粒凶星！属猪人士将「表明风光，地位提升」，是好还是坏？年初二，桃李满门的低音大提琴导师，找来四名学生合作演奏中国民谣<凤阳花鼓；其中两位还是其公子，从小就习琴。要学好低音大提琴，时间管理最重要！众学生还分享学习得着，以及出外表演的深刻点滴。「睇𩠌食饭」，潮州菜师傅许美德以龙虾及马蹄，示范贺年菜「龙马精神」。

programme.title: 鼎爷做节攻略粤
programme.desc: 鼎爷以樱花虾、梅菜、五花腩、豆腐四种简单食材炮制出宴客佳肴。留意咸梅菜与甜梅菜的比例，切碎后以白镬烘干，然后与五花腩拌匀舖在豆腐上蒸熟，最后淋上泡油后的樱花虾是精粹所在！紧接鼎爷制作「黄金豆腐」，豆腐先浸在卤水中至入味，切粒后蘸脆浆炸香，配上XO酱同吃别有一番风味。以鸡入馔可谓过节必备，鼎爷特以鸡项制作「葱油鸡」。留意蒸鸡方法，鸡只蒸好后斩件，接着淋上文火炸香的葱油，葱香配嫩滑鸡肉味道一流！

programme.title: 中年好声音3红白大战粤
programme.desc: 下半场先来「国风对决」，曹越、刘晓昆、陈嘉琦的<糖不甩，穿上戏曲服饰的赵浚承、陆东成等以<新禅院钟声应战。紧接是「四王四后」比拼，两队各派四人模仿九十年代天王、天后，星味十足。善玥澄、刘晓昆、阮慧珊、侯静伊、钟凯莹化身性感女团送上<似火探戈和<烈焰红唇，这场「热舞激战」白队会如何应对？终极回合的「梦想解码」，两队会合力演绎动人舞台剧。另外，陈芷盈、占士丁丁会带来为登峰之战准备的决胜快歌。

programme.title: Sunday靓声王粤
programme.desc: 「香港鬼才」黄沾为乐坛留下大量优秀的音乐作品，首首歌曲都耐人寻味，区瑞强、林一峰、林二汶、杜丽莎、李龙基、胡琳、袁丽嫦，以及沾叔第一任妻子华娃，分别演绎沾叔创作的经典歌曲。主持人则论尽沾叔的传奇往事。

programme.title: 陷入纯情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成郑敬淏爱与复仇的心脏奇迹】没血没泪的冷酷企业代表姜敏浩，有著先天扩张性心藏病，面对随时有可能死亡的恐惧感，做起事来比谁都还心狠手辣。幼年父亲去世时，叔叔夺走了父亲的公司，高层主管们也纷纷选择背叛，庞大压力下母亲选择轻生留下敏浩一人。复仇心的驱使下，他成为GoldPartners的投资专家，同时也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大债权人团体，看似成功之际，却心脏病发命在旦夕，所幸出现心脏捐赠者，重生的他因细胞记忆而变得温暖，甚至对仇人女儿产生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的疗愈爱情故事。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心机渣男出轨妻子闺蜜为夺下豪门不择手段！】人人称羡的模范夫妻申明燮与韩善珠，在纪念婚礼当天揭开了幸福假象。出身豪门的善珠外表完美，内心却藏著被背叛的恐惧；出身贫寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻转人生却陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美罗，不仅成为他的灵魂寄托，更在命运的捉弄下与善珠结为好友。当真相逐步揭开，爱与恨、正宫与小三的界线逐渐模糊，一场婚礼，也预告了一场悲剧的开始。

programme.title: 韩国小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李圣旻社区大叔们联手打造韩国小姐】高中时自恃美貌过人，而没有好好念书的吴智英，毕业后凭借外表当上百货的电梯小姐，看似光鲜亮丽的工作，背后隐藏著许多辛酸，面对毛手毛脚的变态上司，以及百货种种不合理的工作规定，年纪增长且缺乏竞争力另吴智英后悔莫及，偶然的机会下，与现职化妆品公司社长的前男友相遇，公司即将倒闭的金亨俊，与债主郑先生一同把平凡女孩打造为顶级韩国小姐的励志故事。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 依法相爱吧(完)
programme.desc: 【李升基×李世荣二次合作，青梅竹马谱出律政罗曼史！！】改编自人气网路小说，「怪物天才检察官」金正浩与「韩国小姐出身律师」金琉璃，青梅竹马重逢后，一起经营「LawCafé」的故事。既是律师事务所、又是咖啡馆的小天地里，用温暖的饮品与犀利的法律智慧，帮助无数人伸张正义。从法庭到日常，辩论化为斗嘴，正义化为浪漫，疗愈又甜蜜的爱情由此展开。

programme.title: 落花时节又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋强撩告白高冷花神刘学义，大谈反差萌恋！！】不懂情爱、呆萌率直的小花妖红凝，为了报恩误闯仙界，却意外发现自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身为花神的锦绣。红凝大胆示爱，直言想当锦绣的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡觉就是要陪他洗澡，让这位必须断情绝爱、恪守仙妖界限的未来天帝继承者瞬间乱了方寸。

programme.title: 监狱医生
programme.desc: 【《千元律师》南宫珉恶斗《车贞淑医生》金炳哲，权贵复仇大秀帝王级演技！！】出身无名大学的罗以载，原为大学医院急诊中心的王牌，因医疗事故而吊销医生执照，重新考取医生执照并申请到监狱医疗科，开始进行复仇之路，成为监狱的医疗科长并成功掌握了名门大学医院理事会。真实体现没有自己不沾血就能打赢的战争。

programme.title: 小欢喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龙！都会家庭的高考大作战】以三个家庭为主轴，方圆和童文洁一家三口，他们的儿子方一凡即将面临高考，但父母的压力与儿子的无忧形成鲜明对比，使得家庭关系逐渐紧张。另一方面，单亲妈妈宋倩与女儿乔英子的生活也充满了挑战，前夫的纠缠和女儿的叛逆让她左右为难。最后，季杨杨从小被寄养在舅舅家，父母突然的关怀让他陷入矛盾，父亲季胜利努力与他建立亲子关系，但结果并不理想。这些家庭的故事交织在一起，展现了现代都市生活中家庭、亲情和成长的种种困境和温暖时刻。

programme.title: 依法相爱吧(完)
programme.desc: 【李升基×李世荣二次合作，青梅竹马谱出律政罗曼史！！】改编自人气网路小说，「怪物天才检察官」金正浩与「韩国小姐出身律师」金琉璃，青梅竹马重逢后，一起经营「LawCafé」的故事。既是律师事务所、又是咖啡馆的小天地里，用温暖的饮品与犀利的法律智慧，帮助无数人伸张正义。从法庭到日常，辩论化为斗嘴，正义化为浪漫，疗愈又甜蜜的爱情由此展开。

programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋强撩告白高冷花神刘学义，大谈反差萌恋！！】不懂情爱、呆萌率直的小花妖红凝，为了报恩误闯仙界，却意外发现自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身为花神的锦绣。红凝大胆示爱，直言想当锦绣的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡觉就是要陪他洗澡，让这位必须断情绝爱、恪守仙妖界限的未来天帝继承者瞬间乱了方寸。

programme.title: 依法相爱吧
programme.desc: 【李升基×李世荣二次合作，青梅竹马谱出律政罗曼史！！】改编自人气网路小说，「怪物天才检察官」金正浩与「韩国小姐出身律师」金琉璃，青梅竹马重逢后，一起经营「LawCafé」的故事。既是律师事务所、又是咖啡馆的小天地里，用温暖的饮品与犀利的法律智慧，帮助无数人伸张正义。从法庭到日常，辩论化为斗嘴，正义化为浪漫，疗愈又甜蜜的爱情由此展开。

programme.title: 小欢喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龙！都会家庭的高考大作战】以三个家庭为主轴，方圆和童文洁一家三口，他们的儿子方一凡即将面临高考，但父母的压力与儿子的无忧形成鲜明对比，使得家庭关系逐渐紧张。另一方面，单亲妈妈宋倩与女儿乔英子的生活也充满了挑战，前夫的纠缠和女儿的叛逆让她左右为难。最后，季杨杨从小被寄养在舅舅家，父母突然的关怀让他陷入矛盾，父亲季胜利努力与他建立亲子关系，但结果并不理想。这些家庭的故事交织在一起，展现了现代都市生活中家庭、亲情和成长的种种困境和温暖时刻。

programme.title: 现在开始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操纵幻术的魔术师朴海镇×通灵女警秦基周，灵异喜剧Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔术师车次雄，不仅能操纵幻术，还能使唤鬼魂，这群「幽灵助手」是他的得力伙伴。热血女警高瑟海，拥有通灵能力，她对灵异现象毫不畏惧。两人因一起调查超自然案件而结盟，一边与鬼神合作，一边大展魔术与正义力量。当喜剧、灵异与调查结合，爱情与真相也心动牵引。

programme.title: 陷入纯情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成郑敬淏爱与复仇的心脏奇迹】没血没泪的冷酷企业代表姜敏浩，有著先天扩张性心藏病，面对随时有可能死亡的恐惧感，做起事来比谁都还心狠手辣。幼年父亲去世时，叔叔夺走了父亲的公司，高层主管们也纷纷选择背叛，庞大压力下母亲选择轻生留下敏浩一人。复仇心的驱使下，他成为GoldPartners的投资专家，同时也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大债权人团体，看似成功之际，却心脏病发命在旦夕，所幸出现心脏捐赠者，重生的他因细胞记忆而变得温暖，甚至对仇人女儿产生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的疗愈爱情故事。

programme.title: 女王之家(完)
programme.desc: 【心机渣男出轨妻子闺蜜为夺下豪门不择手段！】人人称羡的模范夫妻申明燮与韩善珠，在纪念婚礼当天揭开了幸福假象。出身豪门的善珠外表完美，内心却藏著被背叛的恐惧；出身贫寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻转人生却陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美罗，不仅成为他的灵魂寄托，更在命运的捉弄下与善珠结为好友。当真相逐步揭开，爱与恨、正宫与小三的界线逐渐模糊，一场婚礼，也预告了一场悲剧的开始。

programme.title: 韩国小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李圣旻社区大叔们联手打造韩国小姐】高中时自恃美貌过人，而没有好好念书的吴智英，毕业后凭借外表当上百货的电梯小姐，看似光鲜亮丽的工作，背后隐藏著许多辛酸，面对毛手毛脚的变态上司，以及百货种种不合理的工作规定，年纪增长且缺乏竞争力另吴智英后悔莫及，偶然的机会下，与现职化妆品公司社长的前男友相遇，公司即将倒闭的金亨俊，与债主郑先生一同把平凡女孩打造为顶级韩国小姐的励志故事。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 现在开始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操纵幻术的魔术师朴海镇×通灵女警秦基周，灵异喜剧Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔术师车次雄，不仅能操纵幻术，还能使唤鬼魂，这群「幽灵助手」是他的得力伙伴。热血女警高瑟海，拥有通灵能力，她对灵异现象毫不畏惧。两人因一起调查超自然案件而结盟，一边与鬼神合作，一边大展魔术与正义力量。当喜剧、灵异与调查结合，爱情与真相也心动牵引。

programme.title: 落花时节又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋强撩告白高冷花神刘学义，大谈反差萌恋！！】不懂情爱、呆萌率直的小花妖红凝，为了报恩误闯仙界，却意外发现自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身为花神的锦绣。红凝大胆示爱，直言想当锦绣的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡觉就是要陪他洗澡，让这位必须断情绝爱、恪守仙妖界限的未来天帝继承者瞬间乱了方寸。

programme.title: 监狱医生
programme.desc: 【《千元律师》南宫珉恶斗《车贞淑医生》金炳哲，权贵复仇大秀帝王级演技！！】出身无名大学的罗以载，原为大学医院急诊中心的王牌，因医疗事故而吊销医生执照，重新考取医生执照并申请到监狱医疗科，开始进行复仇之路，成为监狱的医疗科长并成功掌握了名门大学医院理事会。真实体现没有自己不沾血就能打赢的战争。

programme.title: 小欢喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龙！都会家庭的高考大作战】以三个家庭为主轴，方圆和童文洁一家三口，他们的儿子方一凡即将面临高考，但父母的压力与儿子的无忧形成鲜明对比，使得家庭关系逐渐紧张。另一方面，单亲妈妈宋倩与女儿乔英子的生活也充满了挑战，前夫的纠缠和女儿的叛逆让她左右为难。最后，季杨杨从小被寄养在舅舅家，父母突然的关怀让他陷入矛盾，父亲季胜利努力与他建立亲子关系，但结果并不理想。这些家庭的故事交织在一起，展现了现代都市生活中家庭、亲情和成长的种种困境和温暖时刻。

programme.title: 小欢喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龙！都会家庭的高考大作战】以三个家庭为主轴，方圆和童文洁一家三口，他们的儿子方一凡即将面临高考，但父母的压力与儿子的无忧形成鲜明对比，使得家庭关系逐渐紧张。另一方面，单亲妈妈宋倩与女儿乔英子的生活也充满了挑战，前夫的纠缠和女儿的叛逆让她左右为难。最后，季杨杨从小被寄养在舅舅家，父母突然的关怀让他陷入矛盾，父亲季胜利努力与他建立亲子关系，但结果并不理想。这些家庭的故事交织在一起，展现了现代都市生活中家庭、亲情和成长的种种困境和温暖时刻。

programme.title: 落花时节又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋强撩告白高冷花神刘学义，大谈反差萌恋！！】不懂情爱、呆萌率直的小花妖红凝，为了报恩误闯仙界，却意外发现自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身为花神的锦绣。红凝大胆示爱，直言想当锦绣的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡觉就是要陪他洗澡，让这位必须断情绝爱、恪守仙妖界限的未来天帝继承者瞬间乱了方寸。

programme.desc: The Teletubbies have their favourite things and The Noo-Noo wants to join in. When the Tubby Phone rings, the Teletubbies and The Noo-Noo do the Tubby Phone Dance together.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Feng's innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaire's Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her master's Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fan's daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fan's friend along the way.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: The Kid with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: The government hires Yang to escort a cargo of gold to a famine stricken area. The vicious Chi Sha gang, with one of their best fighters, Golden Arm, announce their intention to hijack it by killing one of Yang's employees. As Yang gathers his own team of reputable fighters to protect his cargo, are they strong enough to hold off Golden Arm?

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobra's blood and swallowing the magic toad, eventually defeating his father's old rival.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous "Finger of Doom", a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji; and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a pretty fraud, steals a brilliant diamond ring from a shop in Hong Kong and escapes to Singapore. To smuggle the ring pass customs, Hua slips it into the pocket of a stranger, Yen, but then lost track of him. Hua finally spots Yen after searching for days and does everything to get close to him in order to take the ring back.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shih's magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Godfather of Canton
programme.desc: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster.

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Ming's guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fiance. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: The film is about a Chinese martial arts school finds itself outclassed by their rivals, they hire elite ninja from Japan to destroy the school. The lone survivor of the massacre learns the secrets of ninjutsu and seeks revenge against the ninja.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage. A heartless tycoon plans to take over the orphanage for its land but has to deal with Seventh Sister's magical powers as she aims to protect it from falling into his hands!

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy "House of 72 tenants", this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society’s conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi’s husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Dummy Mommy, without a Baby
programme.desc: Fong Lai Kuen works at an advertising agency but is about to be sacked by her boss after offending him. She pretends to be pregnant so that the company cannot fire her, according to the labour law. Since then, Fong receives much care and love from her colleagues and begins to feel guilty about her lie as things develop out of her expectations.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law’s affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother’s death?

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Ignition

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Pete The Polar Bear

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Come And Play Slugsy

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Bumble's Magic
programme.desc: Bumble is practicing for his magic show… but he has made the twins disappear! Can Fifi help him find them before the big show?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Aunt Tulip's Carnival
programme.desc: All the tots are excited as Aunt Tulip is holding a Caribbean themed carnival. But will the weather hold long enough for them to have their celebrations?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Storm
programme.desc: It is a windy day in the garden, Fifi's washing has blown away. Poppy offers to find it, but she gets caught in the storm. The other tots set out to find her and spend a wild night out in the open.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Wasps
programme.desc: Stingo is very depressed. All the tots have noticed it. They decide to organise a very special "wasp" surprise for Stingo.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Slugsy Won't Slide

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Flowertot Taxi
programme.desc: Stingo is sure he is on to a good thing when he decides to start up a taxi service using… slug power! Slugsy is soon exhausted and unable to keep up with the demand

She imagines herself curing all kinds of wild animals, and back home she goes to work on the only two patients available: her pets! Her treatments for Edwin and Perry turn out to be a bit messier than she expected.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Becomes A Chef

programme.desc: Smidge tries to rescue the Trolls after thinking she has magical powers DJ Suki tries to impress her favorite niece CJ Suki

programme.desc: Smudge tries to prove to Fox and Stick that his monster friend is realJulio teaches Smek how to "chill out" but Smek takes it too far

programme.title: Dinotrux S3 - Lil' Dread

Kelp goes to his Dad for answers, and two seemingly different ingredients form something magical. When Cruz is not his usual upbeat self, Kelp tries various ways to cheer him up before realizing the best way to be a good friend is to just sit with him, and let him feel what he’s feeling.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Frank and Beans with Chili Little Hound on the Prairie

Tag’s ancestor, Tagatha, built a steam-engine and turned Pawston from a one-house town into a thriving community.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Rodney the Hero Club Shed

When the Dew Drops struggle to help their kids with tasks that are outside their usual fairy-bilities, they decide to swap kids for the day, but ultimately learn they’ re exactly where they need to be because they know their families so well!

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - An Echo of Nowhere
programme.desc: Now in Rafaela’s custody, the crew works together to break Echo out to retrieve the hauler. Echo makes it into the jungle and must battle a mind-controlled Ms. Nowhere using everything she’s learned about spying and survival from the very woman who's out to get her. Meanwhile, Rafaela enlists Frostee to help her develop a non-exploding version of the mind control formula before her plan goes into motion at the favela race.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Patroness
programme.desc: Echo and Ms. Nowhere bust Cisco, Frostee, and Gary out of their cell. But Rafaela has already mind controlled Tony and Layla and taken them to drive for her in the favela race, allowing her to release her mind control formula on the crowd!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Tchau, Uggos
programme.desc: Our team battles Rafaela’s mind-controlled crowd. They soon discover that Rafaela’s true plan is to steal the spy plane. Tony deduces that Rafaela isn’t doing all of this for the money - she’s doing it for family.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - Baddie Issues
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - A Family Friend
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Grug Vs Math Footless
programme.desc: Amber announces that math is the new skill that every hunter must have. Grug cannot seems to grasp the concept and enlists Squawk to help himGrug and Snoot ban dancing when it causes a rock slide. Eep sets up an underground dance club against the adults' wishes.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - The Good Surprise Nightmare On Eep Street
programme.desc: When Ugga's new surprise attack fails, and she comes home in a bad mood, Thunk tries to cure it by finding a happy surprise for his mom Eep stays up all night to see the mysterious and rare Night Mare (a horse with a rainbow mane) when she's teased for thinking they're not real.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - What Screams May Come Grunt Anything
programme.desc: Eep joins the Scream-Leading team and starts picking up characteristics of her coach, Meep, much to Ugga's chagrinMeep kicks Snoot out of the cave for not being a brave hunter. The Croods reluctantly take Snoot in and try to make him into a hunter to get him out of their home.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants And The Senseless Torment Of The Space Toilet
programme.desc: Inspired by their favorite TV show, George and Harold - along with Principal Krupp - blast off to outer space, where an angry toilet awaits.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Abandoned Artifact of the Absentee Aliens
programme.desc: After George and Harold learn the truth about their mission, Dupe Licitous enlists the entire crew in a quest to repair a rogue satellite.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Hazardous Hysteria of the Hangry Hypnosinger
programme.desc: Everybody on the spaceship has been cryogenically frozen for three months - everyone, that is, except Krupp, who's wide awake and happily in charge.
